categories.main_business_segments: Daehan Synthetic Fiber Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two business segments: manufacturing and leasing. The manufacturing segment focuses on producing polyester filament yarns, while the leasing segment involves leasing land and buildings of its factories in locations such as Ulsan, Daegu, and Busan. The company also engages in export-import activities and related businesses.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in polyester filament manufacturing using advanced spinning technology with a production capacity of 65,700 tons annually at its Ulsan plant. It utilizes petrochemical raw materials such as PTA and chips, sourced both domestically and internationally. The production process emphasizes optimization and efficiency improvements to enhance cost competitiveness.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Daehan Synthetic Fiber serves domestic and international customers including textile manufacturers, distributors, and end-users in apparel and industrial materials sectors. Major customers include companies like HAKFA INSAAT, Dubest, Bucheon, Ashfar Enterprises, and Huvis. The company’s products are used in various applications including fabrics and industrial materials, with a growing focus on eco-friendly and functional fibers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in South Korea with manufacturing facilities in Ulsan, Daegu, and Busan. It also exports polyester products globally, with export sales constituting a significant portion of revenue. Overseas operations include affiliated companies and representative offices, supporting global marketing and sales expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: Daehan Synthetic Fiber operates midstream in the synthetic fiber supply chain, focusing on the production of polyester filament yarns from petrochemical raw materials. It sources raw materials such as PTA and chips from petrochemical suppliers and supplies finished polyester yarns to textile manufacturers and distributors downstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus includes optimizing production efficiency, enhancing cost competitiveness, and expanding sales of differentiated, high-value-added products such as eco-friendly recycled yarns and antimicrobial fibers. It emphasizes global marketing expansion and collaboration with leading companies to develop next-generation growth engines. Continuous R&D efforts target sustainable and functional fiber technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of polyester filament yarns, accounting for over 90% of total sales, with the remainder from leasing income. Sales are made via direct domestic and export channels, with payment terms including cash, notes, and letters of credit. The company also earns rental income from leasing its real estate assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Daehan Synthetic Fiber holds a competitive position in the polyester filament market with a market share of approximately 16% in 2023. Major competitors include Hyosung (36%), Toray Advanced Materials (27%), Huvis (12%), and others. The polyester industry is characterized by both commodity and differentiated product segments, with Daehan focusing on differentiated, high-value products to maintain competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported total revenues of approximately 134.4 billion KRW, with polyester sales contributing 123.7 billion KRW. The company experienced a revenue decline of about 10.9% compared to the previous year, with operating profit decreasing by 62.5%. Total assets stood at approximately 860.9 billion KRW, and the company maintains a stable financial structure with an equity ratio of 83.3% and a debt ratio of 20.05%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Daehan Synthetic Fiber differentiates itself through stable quality, timely supply, and development of eco-friendly and functional fibers such as recycled and antimicrobial yarns. The company leverages production optimization and cost competitiveness alongside global marketing efforts to expand high-margin differentiated products. Its value proposition centers on sustainability, innovation, and reliability to meet evolving market demands.
